lines.text: Exemption filed. The herd is protected under clause 9(c). Do not tell Foreman Orrin.
The slot is still empty. I will keep it open.
One more thing. I have a blank stamp. It does nothing. It could do something, in the right hands.

choice.text: Use it for the Well Line exemption.
Burn the blank stamp. Nobody should hold that.

lines.text: Hm. Section four, paragraph two. That could work.
That would be an act against the Dominion. Noted. Not reported.
